column3: The Hebrew title is only “Of David”; NASB sets “A Psalm of David” in braces before verse 1. “Lest You be silent … and I be like” is rendered “For if You are silent … I will become like.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the innermost room of Your holiness” is rendered “Your holy sanctuary.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the refuge of the salvations” is rendered “a saving defense.”
Close to the Hebrew; “shepherd them” is rendered “Be their shepherd.”
